jobs.subject: Balak — Bring Down the Sky (ME1)
jobs.work: Mass Effect 1: Bring Down the Sky
jobs.referenceLimit: Capture précise du visage et du haut de l’armure ME1; jambes et dos non documentés par une vue complète exploitable.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one high-detail full-body 2D game character sprite of Balak, the batarian leader from Mass Effect 1: Bring Down the Sky, matching the attached actual Legendary Edition screenshot for his precise face and upper-body costume. One character, one pose, head and both feet completely visible with generous transparent margins. Three-quarter side view facing right, calm ready guard stance, slight knee bend, hands held ready without a weapon or energy effect. Adult batarian male with the four black eyes in two distinct stacked pairs, broad flattened facial structure, olive-green/brown skin, intricate dark forehead ridges and facial folds, small pale lower lip and chin region, and the exact facial markings seen in the reference. Wear his burgundy/maroon segmented ME1 combat armor with the reference's broad curved shoulder plates, layered maroon chest plates, small red circular fasteners and gray metallic borders over black ribbed undersuit; preserve the normal ME1 armored silhouette through the waist, knee plates and boots, without inventing a robe, heavy krogan armor or his later civilian ME3 costume. Realistic adult proportions, polished finely painted game sprite with crisp solid volumes and subtle material texture, no pixel art, no chibi. Keep the anatomy, four-eye layout and burgundy palette faithful. Soft neutral illumination; actual transparent RGBA background with completely clear negative space, no scenery, no ground plane, no cast-shadow patch, no outline halo. Output one figure only, no UI, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no collage or alternate views.

jobs.subject: Kai Leng — apparence ME3
jobs.referenceLimit: Capture du visage/haut d’armure provenant des recherches historiques; planche de modèle redistribuée attribuée à Troodon80, source secondaire à comparer au jeu.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one high-detail full-body 2D game sprite of Kai Leng in his released Mass Effect 3 appearance. Use reference image 1 for his canonical face, black hair, angular dark metallic cybernetic eye visor with narrow pale blue-white light slits, exposed mouth, cheek and forehead attachments, black armored shoulders and small gold Cerberus chest symbol. Use reference image 2 only as a full-body model reference to preserve the segmented charcoal torso armor, dark short coat tails beside the hips, light silver-gray textured thigh panels and upper trousers, black armored kneepads, long black armored boots, gloves and thin amber mechanical accents on the forearms. Do not copy the reference sheet arrangement or background characters: output exactly ONE figure and ONE pose. Whole head and both boots visible with generous clear margins, three-quarter side view facing right, controlled neutral ready stance with slightly bent knees and both hands held naturally near the torso, no drawn weapon and no power effects. Preserve the game's lean adult male proportions and the actual visor; no full-face helmet, no white Cerberus fan-mod armor, no cybernetic robot legs from early concepts. Finely painted high-definition sprite with realistic proportions, clear solid volumes and restrained metallic highlights, no pixel art, no chibi. Soft neutral light. Genuine transparent RGBA background with completely clear negative space, no scenery, no floor, no shadow patch, no outline halo, no text, no title, no watermark, no sheet or multiple poses.
